scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @hakit/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config ../../wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs sessions and proves you own this instance at `/setup`. Any random string of 32+ characters (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`). Keep a copy: you paste it once at `/setup`.

TOKEN_ENC_KEY.description: Encrypts GitHub tokens and the GitHub App credentials stored in D1. Any random string of 32+ characters, different from SESSION_SECRET. Keep it stable: changing it means setting up GitHub again.
